reason: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that improves interface readability by collapsing intermediate agent trajectories while keeping user messages and final outputs visible.

summaries.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面的轨迹折叠插件，可按轮次隐藏中间思考、工具调用和上下文行，同时保留用户消息与 Agent 最终输出。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness web interface plugin that collapses intermediate agent reasoning, tool calls, and context rows by round while keeping user messages and final outputs visible.

capabilities: Hides selected agent trajectory nodes with injected CSS
Adds per-round collapse controls and a settings option to the web interface
